The OpenXR headers of the Khronos OpenXR SDK 1.1.63
(https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK), Apache-2.0 OR MIT
(SPDX-License-Identifier in each file). The VR mode's host
(port/linux/arm64/host_vr.c) compiles against them and loads the OpenXR
runtime itself, so the build needs no OpenXR package.
